'''Jun Fukuyama''' (Japanese: '''福山潤''' ''Fukuyama Jun'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Fukuyama was born on November 26, 1978 in {{wp|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama}}, {{wp|Hiroshima Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actor and singer as an adult. Fukuyama started out voicing various [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] during {{aniseries|RS}} and {{aniseries|BW}}. Later, he voiced {{ga|Blue}} for the spin-off series of [[Pokémon Generations]]. In {{aniseries|SM}}, Fukuyama gained his most notable role as [[Hau]], one of {{Ash}}'s [[rival]]s. Fukuyama was once affiliated with Production Baobab before he switched to Black ship. He also won both Best Leading Actor and Overseas Fan's Award during the {{wp|1st Seiyu Awards}} of 2007 and the {{wp|3rd Seiyu Awards}} of 2009, respectively.
